title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
why_read: A practical benchmark for testing whether AI coding agents can correctly port ML repositories between PyTorch/GPU and JAX/TPU ecosystems.
analysis: XStack tests AI agents on a concrete, high-value task: migrating a full PyTorch GPU codebase to a working JAX TPU codebase, judged against the original paper's published results. Current pass rates are low, topping out at 75% for the best agent and dropping to 40% or worse for most others, showing this is still a hard, unsolved problem. This matters because framework and hardware lock-in is a real pain point in ML research, and reliable automated migration could meaningfully increase hardware flexibility. It's a useful, well-scoped benchmark rather than a flashy claim, which makes it a solid contribution for anyone tracking AI coding agent capabilities on real-world software engineering tasks.
